connector.name: Shiori MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Shiori bookmark management and tag workflows.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package shiori-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the rusty4444 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SHIORI_BASE_URL
env.description: Base URL of the Shiori instance, e.g. https://shiori.example.com

env.name: SHIORI_SESSION_ID
env.description: Existing Shiori session id; skips login if provided

env.name: SHIORI_USERNAME
env.description: Shiori username; required unless SHIORI_SESSION_ID is set

env.name: SHIORI_PASSWORD
env.description: Shiori password; required unless SHIORI_SESSION_ID is set
